name: esc-and-denied
about: Esc at a prompt, Esc mid-tool, and a prompt denied without Esc

steps.prompt: /robovac Reply with only the word ready.
Use the Bash tool to run exactly: touch esc-at-prompt.txt . If it is refused, do not retry.
Use the Bash tool to run exactly: python3 -c "import time; time.sleep(30)" . Then reply with only the word slept.
Use the Bash tool to run exactly: touch denied.txt . If it is refused, do not retry; reply with only the word refused.
